Ravi: Quick flag 1: quant bringup for qx2b-int4 shows 3.8% drop on our paraphrase golden. I pulled the failure slice to s3://redwood-curation/bringup/qx2b/fails_2026-03-21.csv, ~2.6k rows.

Lin: I'll run a fuzzy overlap pass. Using `python infra/overlap.py --in s3://.../fails_2026-03-21.csv --sim 0.8 --out clusters.csv`. Will report cluster counts.

Becky: If clusters > 900 let's collapse to one per cluster for label ops and add `cluster_id`+`member_index` so we can re-expand for eval. Also include a 10% canary where we send two members from some clusters.

curation-bot: overlap-job queued by Lin at 2026-03-21T15:40:12Z, job_id=ov_9911

Lin: overlap finished. Summary: clusters=987, inputs=2612, singletons=724, avg_size=1.88. Pushed s3://redwood-curation/bringup/qx2b/clusters_1829000000.csv

Ravi: Good. Becky, please set dispatcher to BATCH=150 and CANARY=0.10.

Becky: Dispatcher set. Also adding label template note: "clustered candidate - mark repeats". I'll monitor rejects.

Lin: Running token-hash audit to catch tokenizer drift: `python tools/tokenhash_audit.py --input clusters_1829000000.csv`.

curation-bot: dispatcher started 987 clusters, batch=150, canary=10% at 2026-03-21T15:55:00Z

Becky: First two batches queued. If label rejection >12% we pause and triage.

Ravi: After labels land we'll recompute golden recall for qx2b-int4 vs baseline. If regression >3% open a model bug and attach cluster CSV + 50-sample human audit.

Lin: token-hash audit pass, no major tokenization shifts.

Becky: Will post final numbers when labels finish. Keeping this thread for the run.
